name: Adhesive PCB leg with proven M3 gripping profile
print_origin: Pole axis at X0,Y0; flat adhesive face at Z0; PCB seating face at Z18

base.adhesive_surface: Entire flat underside; no recess or screw breakthrough

screw_bore.interpretation: M3 screw enters from the PCB back, through its hole, into the top of the leg. The upper4.5mm copies the supplied rail aperture exactly; the larger pocket below receives the screw tip without adding gripping length.

assembly.initial_screw: M3 x8mm, length under head; non-countersunk head
assembly.note: Screw/hole passage, printing and adhesive grip need the actual hardware check. The existing PCB is not modified.

print.orientation: Flat adhesive base on the bed; screw opening upward
print.supports: No external supports; the small internal relief-to-grip shoulder is a new print feature
print.process: Use the same material, printer and hole compensation as the proven reference when practical; dimensions are unscaled CAD geometry.
